approximationNotes: Two broadside images do not metrically determine hidden thickness or internal bolt geometry.

Strict CS2 silhouette target 0.90 is not yet met; the current deterministic masks are 0.8344 front and 0.8329 back after the stock/thumbhole, trigger-guard, and magazine correction while preserving the source-fitted scope.

Scope-only review: optic span and taper now fit the 500x180 reference crop; rings, turret, marking, crown, and shortened rail are separate attached real components. Clamp machining and hidden underside thickness remain procedural approximations.

Orbit repair loop: the stock opening is a source-shaped rounded rectangle with real bevel strips; the bolt handle grows from a named attached circular receiver boss; the folded bipod remains a continuous real tube/spring assembly but is mounted 0.10 units toward the receiver to match the source projection. Hidden wall texture and internal action remain approximate.
Medusa paint is a shell-only curved projection from supplied pixels; it is not used as structural geometry.
The thumbhole is a real extruded stock cut with a projection cutout; hidden thickness and interior hardware remain inferred.
